evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit Bangladesh on 25 May 2009 with a 2–6 m storm surge; 243,191 houses washed away and 370,587 partially damaged.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila and the storm surge killed 33 people; 3,520 houses washed away; 1,800 partially damaged; almost the entire union inundated.
Storm surge overtopped and breached the coastal embankment in six places (20.55 km damaged); villages inundated twice daily until polder rehabilitation in 2013.
